PLAN "Upper Body Strength – Subacromial Impingement Recovery"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper body strength within pain-free range"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Scapular Stability" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Pull & Scapular":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          lat_stretch 90s
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Horizontal Press & Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          back_stretch 90s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Grip & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          farmers_walk 3x40m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          back_extension 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 90s
          back_stretch 90s
